content: For UTC-internal TZ-aware scheduling: stdlib zoneinfo (3.9+) is the base IANA tz database access, no runtime type safety for naive/aware mixing. Pendulum wraps datetime, defaults to UTC, strict about naive datetimes, but has known DST edge-case warnings. Arrow is popular but not DST-safe and has erratic API behavior. whenever (Rust-backed, typed aware/naive distinction, DST-safe, fast) is the newest and safest but pre-1.0 (0.3.x-0.8.x range), smaller ecosystem/adoption. Recommendation: stdlib datetime+zoneinfo as the wire/storage type (aware, UTC) for max compatibility with SQLAlchemy/asyncpg, no extra dependency; consider whenever only for internal interval-math correctness if pre-1.0 risk is acceptable.
